$comment: Real block and transaction CBOR, with the values the ledger records for them. To add a new era, drop its block CBOR hex in blocks/ and add an entry here. The transactions added for parser coverage (from shelley-pool-registration-relays on) take their values from Koios tx_info, except certificateCount, which counts the certificates in the CBOR (Koios splits MIR and combined certificates into several rows). `synthetic` lists the fixtures synthetic/build.mjs writes for shapes no real transaction was found for; they are only checked against their golden output. Every synthetic transaction also has an output with an empty multiasset map. `deep` lists real blocks with items nested deeper than cbors' default maxDepth (1024) and than recursion can walk. Their parsed output is too deep for the goldens (normalize, JSON.stringify and toStrictEqual all recurse), so blocks.spec.ts checks them on their own.
